Shitet Apartament 2+1 buze rr.Bardhyl.
Ndodhet ne katin e 3 te nje pallati 4 kac ( orientim lindje dhe juge-perendim)
Apartamenti eshte i restauriar totalisht nga e para suvatime, elektrike, hidraulike multistrat, tualet inkaso, dyer te reja, dritare plastile dopioxham termike, parket, patinime lyerje etj.
Siperfaqa eshte 63.5 metra por ne certifikat shkruan 58 m².
Cmimi eshte 148k
description_en: Apartment for sale 2+1 buz Bardhyl str. It is located on the 3rd floor of a 4-story building (east and south-west orientation). The apartment is completely restored from scratch, plastering, electrical, multi-layer plumbing, flush toilet, new doors, thermal double-glazed plastic windows, parquet, painting skates, etc. The surface is 63.5 meters, but the certificate says 58 m². The price is 148k
